# `chrome-open` — Visible Desktop Chrome Launcher (`WinSta0\Default`)

Opens one or more URLs or local HTML mockup files directly in John's visible Google Chrome window on `WinSta0\Default`, bypassing offscreen agent sandbox desktops (`exebox-*`) and Session 0 URL association traps.

## Usage
```powershell
python C:/dev/foundry-tools/ft.py chrome-open <url_or_html_file> [more_urls...] [--new-window] [--selftest]
```
